bullets.text: Home built out through the left side. {home_5} found {home_6} between Away's first and second lines with a pass rated Full gain, and {home_3} repeated the pattern into the left half-space.
When Away pressed with both forwards, Home's passes out of the back more often had Partial gain or Low gain. Two clear cases: a pass under high pressure that kept the ball, and one that was lost.
Away's pressing trigger was a pass back to {home_1}. In the cited sequence {home_5} played back under high pressure with few forward options in the ring.
{home_8} received under high pressure while facing his own goal. This moment has lower tracking confidence, so treat the pressure reading with care.
In the second half Home lost the ball in midfield under high pressure, and Away's first action was a long carry through the centre.
{home_10} played the ball back to {home_8} when a forward pass to a teammate in the ring had the higher value. The pass kept possession, and the model rates it Partial gain, not wrong.
{home_9} made an off-ball run into the channel that carried a high movement value, and the next pass from {home_6} went square instead. The run was not found.

limitations: Decision quality is a model estimate from tracked positions. It is not a ground-truth rating of a player.
Readings on frames below 0.75 confidence are marked and should be checked on the pitch before use.
No wearable data is connected, so this brief contains no physical load context.

bullets.text: Home progressed through the centre early in the match. {home_5} and {home_6} played forward into midfield, and both passes carry an event-only estimate rather than a measured rating.
A pass out from the back was lost after the feed tagged a pressure event. The feed records that pressure happened, not how close the opponent was.
A second-half loss in the middle third handed Away the next possession. With no off-ball positions in this feed, Ponta cannot show what Home's shape looked like at that moment.
{home_8} played a long pass to {home_9}, more direct than the passes around it. Alternatives cannot be ranked without player positions.
{home_10} played wide to {home_11} late in the match. The event-only estimate for this pass spans more than one band, and should be read as a range.

limitations: This match has event data only. Decision quality is an estimate from start and end locations, shown as a range, and is not comparable with measured ratings from tracking data.
Opposition pressure, control zones and off-ball movement are Blocked for this match.

One sprint effort has lower signal quality, so its peak speed should be read as approximate.
